note: The single logo asset. Swap this file to change the logo everywhere: site header, dashboard sidebar, docs header, favicons, OG/Twitter images, clip watermark and end card, X avatar and banner. `svg` is the inner markup of a viewBox; {ink} and {accent} are filled per theme.
